_doc: User-scope MCP servers for every project on this workstation. Applied by `claude-tooling-sync apply`, checked by `claude-tooling-sync verify` (also run by check-drift). Env values in ${VAR} form resolve from the session environment; secrets come from ~/.local/secrets (the age store), never from this file. Record every server here in the same session it is added; see ~/.claude/docs/claude-tooling.md.

daisyui-blueprint._why: Official daisyUI Blueprint (licensed 2026-09-13): rules enforcer and read-only quality inspector as the pre-cut admin audit, component syntax expert for plan authorship. Credentials: registry entries DAISYUI_BLUEPRINT_LICENSE and DAISYUI_BLUEPRINT_EMAIL. The launcher (dotfiles bin) sources ~/.local/secrets at spawn and maps the two variables to LICENSE and EMAIL, so a stale login shell cannot starve the server of its key (2026-09-14).

svelte._why: Official Svelte team server: versioned Svelte 5 and SvelteKit 2 docs plus a static check of Svelte code. Every cairn-family site is SvelteKit.

playwright._why: Microsoft's Playwright server: structured DOM inspection for reproducing an e2e failure; distinct from claude-in-chrome, which drives the desktop browser.
